title: Texas Capital Announces the Openings of Three New Offices Nationwide
summary: Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: TCBI) announced it has officially opened offices in New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago, expanding the firm’s physical presence in three of the country’s primer financial markets.
body_markdown:
**DALLAS – September 25, 2026 –** Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: TCBI) announced it has officially opened offices in New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago, expanding the firm’s physical presence in three of the country’s primer financial markets.


These new offices offer clients greater access to personnel in key regions, while the firm’s trading floor in Dallas will continue to host sales and trading operations, including corporate credit, public finance and equity underwriting.


“Texas is our home, but we have clients with a national reach. Having a physical presence in New York, Los Angeles and Chicago allows us to provide them with even greater personalized service,” said[Rob C. Holmes](https://texascapitalbank.com/who-we-are/people/leadership/rob-c-holmes) , Chairman, President & CEO of Texas Capital.


- Texas Capital’s New York City office, located in Midtown Manhattan, supports the firm’s capital markets, investment banking and advisory work, giving clients more direct access to Wall Street and the broader Northeast financial community.
- In Los Angeles, the firm’s Westwood office supports Texas Capital’s growing corporate and investment bank as the firm builds deeper relationships with companies, sponsors and investors across the West Coast.
- In Chicago, the firm’s office in the Loop financial district extends Texas Capital’s reach across the Midwest with team members in commercial real estate, corporate and investment banking.


“We are taking the values, relationships and capabilities we have established in Texas into some of the country's most important financial markets,” Holmes added. “We look forward to helping businesses in these regions navigate complexity, seize opportunities and achieve their ambitions.”


## About Texas Capital


Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ®: TCBI), a member of the Russell 2000® Index and the S&P MidCap 400®, is the parent company of Texas Capital Bank (“TCB”). TCBI Securities, Inc., doing business as Texas Capital Securities, is a subsidiary of Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc., and an affiliate of TCB. TCBI Securities, Inc. is a member of FINRA and SIPC and has registered with the SEC, MSRB, and other state securities regulators as a broker dealer. Texas Capital is the collective brand name for TCB and its separate, non-bank affiliates and wholly owned subsidiaries. Texas Capital is a full-service financial services firm that delivers customized solutions to businesses, entrepreneurs and individual customers. Founded in 1998, the institution is headquartered in Dallas with offices in Austin, Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, Chicago, Los Angeles and New York City, and has a network of clients across the country. With the ability to service clients through their entire lifecycles, Texas Capital has established commercial banking, consumer banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management capabilities. All services are subject to applicable laws, regulations and service terms. Deposit and lending products and services are offered by TCB. For deposit products, member FDIC. For more information, please visit[texascapital.com](https://texascapitalbank.com/) .
